rulesStrings.li: entry(outcome==Backfire) ->[PAWN] negotiated peace talks with [Faction], but they backfired.
entry(outcome==TalksFlounder)->[PAWN] negotiated peace talks with [Faction], but they floundered.
entry(outcome==Success) ->[PAWN] successfully negotiated peace talks with [Faction].
entry(outcome==Triumph) ->[PAWN] negotiated peace talks with [Faction] to a great triumph.
entry(outcome==Disaster) ->[PAWN] negotiated peace talks with [Faction], but they ended in disaster.
entry(outcome==Disaster)->[PAWN][AndOthers] from [Faction] attacked the peace talks delegation.
entry(raidProperty==None) ->[PAWN][AndOthers] from [Faction] raided the colony.[questClause]
entry(raidProperty==Breacher) ->[PAWN][AndOthers] from [Faction] raided the colony using breaching tactics.[questClause]
entry(raidProperty==Sapper) ->[PAWN][AndOthers] from [Faction] raided the colony using sapper tactics.[questClause]
entry(raidProperty==Siege) ->[PAWN][AndOthers] from [Faction] besieged the colony.[questClause]
entry(raidProperty==CenterDrop)->[PAWN][AndOthers] from [Faction] raided the colony by dropping directly into it.[questClause]
questClause(priority=1,quest==ThreatReward_Raid_Joiner)-> [PAWN_pronoun] came to take [QuestAsker].
questClause(priority=1,quest==Intro_Deserter) -> [PAWN_pronoun] came to hunt down [QuestAsker].
questClause(priority=0) -> [PAWN_pronoun] came to attack [QuestAsker].
entry(priority=1,locationType==Settlement)->[PAWN][AndOthers] from [HostileFaction] ambushed the [Colony] at [WorldObject] of [Faction].
entry(priority=1,locationType==Site) ->[PAWN][AndOthers] from [HostileFaction] ambushed the [Colony] at [WorldObject_definite].
entry(priority=0) ->[PAWN][AndOthers] from [HostileFaction] ambushed the [Colony] at [WorldObject].
entry->[PAWN][AndOthers] from [Faction] ambushed [Caravan].
entry(enemyHasFaction==False)->[PAWN][AndOthers] from [Faction] came to aid the colony.
entry(enemyHasFaction==True) ->[PAWN][AndOthers] from [Faction] came to aid the colony against [HostileFaction].
entry(method==Standing)->[PAWN] arrived on foot[WithOthers] to start a new settlement.
entry(method==DropPods)->[PAWN] crash-landed in a drop pod[WithOthers] to start a new settlement.
entry(method==Gravship)->[PAWN] landed in a gravship[WithOthers] to start a new settlement.
entry(reason==Death)->[PAWN] became the new [Faction_leaderTitle] of [Faction] after [OldLeader] died.
entry(reason==Lost)->[PAWN] became the new [Faction_leaderTitle] of [Faction] after [OldLeader] went missing.
entry(action==Attack) ->[PAWN]'s caravan arrived at [WorldObject] to attack [Faction] [WithOthers].
entry(action==Enter,isColony==True) ->[PAWN]'s caravan arrived at the colony [WithOthers].
entry(action==Enter,isColony==False)->[PAWN]'s caravan arrived at [WorldObject] of [Faction] [WithOthers].
entry(action==OfferGifts) ->[PAWN]'s caravan arrived at [WorldObject] [WithOthers] to offer gifts to [Faction].
entry(action==Trade) ->[PAWN]'s caravan arrived at [WorldObject] [WithOthers] to trade with [Faction].
entry(action==VisitEscapeShip) ->[PAWN]'s caravan arrived at the starship [WithOthers] that can be used to escape the planet.
entry(action==VisitPeaceTalks) ->[PAWN]'s caravan arrived for peace talks [WithOthers] to negotiate with [Leader], [Faction_leaderTitle] of [Faction].
entry(action==VisitSite) ->[PAWN]'s caravan arrived at [WorldObject_definite] [WithOthers].
entry(action==VisitSettlement) ->[PAWN]'s caravan visited [WorldObject] of [Faction] [WithOthers].
Holder(transporter==TransportPod)->transport pod
Holder(transporter==Shuttle) ->shuttle
entry(action==Attack) ->[PAWN] arrived at [WorldObject] in a [Holder] [WithOthers] to attack [Faction].
entry(action==Enter,isColony==True) ->[PAWN] arrived at [PlayerSettlement] in a [Holder] [WithOthers].
entry(action==Enter,isColony==False)->[PAWN] arrived at [WorldObject] of [Faction] in a [Holder] [WithOthers].
entry(action==ArriveAsGift) ->[PAWN] arrived at [WorldObject] in a [Holder] [WithOthers] as a gift to [Faction].
entry(action==AddedToCaravan) ->[PAWN] was added to [WorldObject] from a [Holder] [WithOthers].
entry(action==FormCaravan) ->[PAWN] arrived from a [Holder] [WithOthers] to form a new caravan.
entry(action==VisitSite) ->[PAWN] arrived at [WorldObject_definite] in a [Holder] [WithOthers].
entry(action==VisitSpace) ->[PAWN] arrived at [WorldObject_definite] in a [Holder] [WithOthers].
entry(action==VisitSettlement) ->[PAWN] visited [WorldObject] of [Faction] in a [Holder] [WithOthers].
entry(action==TransportShip) ->[PAWN] arrived at [WorldObject_definite] in a [Holder] [WithOthers].
entry->[PAWN] from [Faction] contacted the colony with an offer of information about a persona core that can be used to build a spaceship.
entry->[PAWN] from [Faction] left a gift for the colony: [Gifts].
entry(priority=1,quest==Beggars) ->[PAWN][AlongWithOthers] arrived at [PlayerSettlement] to beg for aid.
entry(priority=1,quest==Intro_Wimp) ->[PAWN] arrived at [PlayerSettlement] asking the colony for help.
entry(priority=1,quest==SanguophageMeetingHost) ->[PAWN][AlongWithOthers] arrived at [PlayerSettlement] for a meeting with the colony.

entry(priority=1,quest==WandererJoins) ->A [PAWN_title] named [PAWN] arrived and joined [PlayerSettlement]. [PAWN_pronoun] is willing to contribute, but refuses to leave voluntarily, claiming to have nowhere else to go.
entry(priority=1,quest==RefugeePodCrash) ->[PAWN_titleIndef] named [PAWN] was crashed in a nearby transport pod. [PAWN_pronoun] survived the impact but was badly wounded.
entry(priority=1,quest==Hospitality_Refugee) ->[PAWN][AndOthers] arrived at [PlayerSettlement] seeking shelter and a place to regroup, with nowhere else to go.
entry(priority=1,quest==ShuttleCrash_Rescue,isEnemy==False)->[PAWN][AlongWithOthers] made an emergency landing at [PlayerSettlement] in a damaged shuttle.
entry(priority=1,quest==ShuttleCrash_Rescue,isEnemy==True) ->[PAWN][AndOthers] from [PAWN_factionName] attacked the crashed shuttle site.
entry(priority=1,quest==ThreatReward_Raid_Joiner,isEnemy==False)->[PAWN] arrived at [PlayerSettlement] under pursuit, and joined the colony in exchange for safety.
entry(priority=1,quest==Intro_Deserter) ->[PAWN] arrived at [PlayerSettlement] seeking protection after deserting the Empire.
entry(priority=0,isEnemy==False) ->[PAWN][AlongWithOthers] arrived at [PlayerSettlement] for [Quest] quest.
entry(priority=0,isEnemy==True) ->[PAWN][AndOthers] from [PAWN_factionName] raided [PlayerSettlement] during [Quest] quest.
entry->During [Quest] quest, [PAWN] believed that [PAWN_pronoun] was happy here, and wished to join [PlayerSettlement] permanently. The colony welcomed [PAWN_objective] in.
entry->[PAWN] arrived as part of a [TraderKind] caravan from [Faction].
entry(reason==Timeout) ->[PAWN] from [TraderKind] of [Faction] began to leave the colony.
entry(reason==DangerousTemperature)->[PAWN] from [TraderKind] of [Faction] began to leave the colony because of dangerous temperature.
entry(reason==AnomalousWeather) ->[PAWN] from [TraderKind] of [Faction] began to leave the colony because of anomalous weather.
entry(reason==Trapped) ->[PAWN] from [TraderKind] of [Faction] attempted to leave because the caravan became trapped inside.
entry(reason==TraderLost) ->[PAWN] from [TraderKind] of [Faction] began to leave the colony after [PAWN_possessive] trader [Trader] was incapacitated.
entry(reason==PackAnimalLost) ->[PAWN] from [TraderKind] of [Faction] began to leave the colony after [PackAnimal_indefinite] was incapacitated.
entry(reason==PawnLost) ->[PAWN] from [TraderKind] of [Faction] began to leave the colony after many of [PAWN_possessive] members were lost.
entry->[PAWN][AndOthers] from [Faction] arrived to visit the colony.
entry->[PAWN][AndOthers] from [Faction] passed by the colony.
entry->[PAWN] was grateful after being rescued. Instead of leaving, [PAWN_pronoun] decided to stay and joined [PlayerFaction].
entry(priority=1,reason==CubeDestroyed)->[PAWN] banished the colony after the golden cube was destroyed.
entry(priority=0,leftToDie==False) ->[PAWN] was banished from [PlayerFaction].
entry(priority=0,leftToDie==True) ->[PAWN] was banished from [PlayerFaction] and left to die.
entry->A [PAWN_kind] living among wild animals wandered into the area. [PAWN_pronoun]'s called [PAWN].
RelClause(hasRelation==True) ->. [PAWN_pronoun] is [Other]'s [Relation]
RelClause(hasRelation==False)->
entry->Sensing trouble, a mysterious [PAWN_kind] named [PAWN] arrived[RelClause]. Would [PAWN_pronoun] be able to set things right in these parts?
entry->[PAWN][AndOthers] stumbled across the remains of the colony and decided to stay. Perhaps they will carry on its story.
